connectors.name: Qichacha · Smart Document Parsing
connectors.summary: Local files / online links · OCR and structured parsing
connectors.description: A single OAuth authorization connects both the remote and the local agent: the remote entry parses publicly accessible PDF/image URLs, while the local entry reads files uploaded or pasted in the chat or given by path, uploads them automatically and outputs Markdown plus structured content. The local entry requires Node.js 20+.

prompts.title: Parse an online document
prompts.text: Parse this online document: paste a publicly accessible PDF or image URL here, and output Markdown with the key fields.

prompts.title: Parse an uploaded file
prompts.text: Parse the PDF or image I uploaded or pasted in this chat, and extract the body text, tables and key fields.

prompts.title: Parse a local file
prompts.text: Parse a local file: replace the file path with ~/Desktop/example.pdf, and output Markdown with a structured summary.

promptVariables.placeholder: e.g. 《民法典》第五百七十七条

prompts.title: Statute and provision search

prompts.title: Typical judicial cases

prompts.title: Citation verification

connectors.name: Wind · Stock Data

connectors.description: Access the Wind stock data service, covering company profiles, share capital and shareholders, market quotes, technical indicators, fundamentals, financial statements, corporate events, and risk and volatility data.
